title: Bulldog Dog Tags: Snore, Drool & Loaf Jokes | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved bulldog dog tags: snoring, gas, loaf and wrinkle jokes on the front, name and number on the back. From $12, ships from Lehi, Utah.
blurb: Engraved tags for the breed that snores through its own name being called. We make them in a house with seven English bulldogs, so the jokes aren't guesses.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved bulldog dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. Polished stainless, paw cut-out, straight off our laser.

tough.h2: Bulldogs are hard on a tag. This one can take it.
tough.html:
A bulldog does not wear a tag so much as marinate it. Drool, slobber, the water bowl they half-climb into, the dirt they plow with their face, the nap in direct sun, the snoring that rattles the whole collar for six hours a night. Printed tags give up. Engraved ones don't.

We cut the words into the metal with a fiber laser. Nothing is painted on, so there's nothing to chip or peel off. On the colored tags, the laser lifts the anodized color and exposes bright silver underneath, so the letters stay readable as the tag gets scratched up. On stainless and brass, the mark goes dark and deep.

Slobber-proof is just a side effect of using metal instead of ink.

Build a tag →

pack.h2: Seven bulldogs, one laser, zero boring tags
pack.html:
We didn't start a tag company because we're crafty. We started it because we have seven English bulldogs in Lehi, Utah, they kept losing their tags, and the plain ones at the pet store cost more than a decent lunch. So we bought a laser and started making our own, with the jokes we were already making out loud.

Whisky's tag came first. Polished stainless, paw cut-out, four lines he did not approve. Everything on this site came after that one.

more.h2: Not a bulldog? We won't hold it against you.
more.lead: Same laser, same metal, same jokes about naps and gas — they just land differently on a greyhound. The main builder has every shape, finish and saying we make, for whatever breed is standing on your foot right now.

sayings.h2: 12 bulldog sayings, field-tested on seven of them
sayings.lead: Front of the tag. Two lines, 24 characters each, which is more than enough to insult your own dog. Name and phone number go on the back where it belongs.
sayings.note: Every line above is 24 characters or fewer, so it fits as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will drool and slobber ruin an engraved bulldog tag?
items.a: No. The words are cut into the metal with a laser, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off. Anodized aluminum, stainless and brass all shrug off water.

items.q: Can I put my bulldog's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name plus your phone number are engraved on the back. A third back line is optional.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for bulldogs?
items.a: Twelve of them on this page, about snoring, gas, wrinkles, the underbite, the loaf shape and the stubbornness. There's a full bulldog category in our sayings list too.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: Custom tags aren't returnable, but if we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Send a photo and we re-cut it. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
